title: Dismissing a history row that is a running delegation's queued follow-up skips successor reassignment
outcome: When cancel_queued_prompt removes a delivery-history row that is a running delegation's queued_followup_prompt_id, it still reassigns the follow-up to a queued User/Human successor and calls prioritize_user_queued_prompts. With no successor, it settles the delegation with an honest reason, such as "follow-up dismissed; its delivery outcome is unknown", instead of leaving it Running with a dangling follow-up id. It still never claims "canceled before it started". Covered by a test. Low from the Claude reviewer (delegation-9bf35347) of the historical-queue-row fix, round 2. That change skipped reconcile_removed_followup_prompt_locked entirely for history rows (session_lifecycle.rs:368) to avoid the false "not sent" claim. The case is rare and currently untested.
acceptance: Dismissing a history row that is a running delegation's queued follow-up skips successor reassignment is done
